caption:
Woke up and can't turn your head? Acute wry neck is common, and it usually settles within days to a week without anything serious going on.

Rather than holding it still, try small, comfortable movements every hour: turning, tilting and nodding within easy range. A heat pack for 15–20 minutes and a pillow that keeps your neck level can help too.

Neck pain after a fall or accident, fever, a severe headache, arm tingling or weakness, dizziness or trouble swallowing need prompt medical attention first.

Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can assess your neck and show you simple ways to keep it moving. Book online via the link in bio.
